annotations.title: URL safety check, scam signals: domain age, redirects and HTTPS

description: Check a link before an agent opens or pays it: where it really leads (each redirect hop, the final URL), the destination domain's age, registrar and trust flags, HTTPS and security headers, and named risk signals (days-old domain, bare IP host, punycode look-alike, user@host trick, chains across many hosts). Heuristic signals from public facts, not a phishing blocklist. Use to vet links in emails, chats and scraped pages, or a payee's website. Example: url=http://github.com. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
